newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK TAX REVENUES ROSE 14.02PCT YR/YR IN JAN 97.
newsitem.headline: GREEK TAX REVENUES ROSE 14.02PCT YR/YR IN JAN 97.

text.p: Greek tax revenues grew 14.02 percent year-on-year in January from 13.4 percent the same month a year earlier, Deputy Finance Minister Nikos Christodoulakis told a news conference.
"This new figure is a sign that revenues are on a good course. It is also in line with our annual growth target which is set at 14.6 percent," said Christodoulakis.
The ministry collected 674 billion drachmas in tax revenues in January against 591 billion in January 1995, he added.
"The implementation of the provisions and terms of the new tax bill has not been accounted for in these figures," he said. --Margarita Sotiropoulou, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
